responsibility: Maintainer-only make fragment for GNU Modula-2 that adds regeneration and paranoid-build rules not needed for ordinary GCC builds. It drives rebuilding of bootstrapped helper tools such as ppg, regenerates generated C/C++ sources and headers from Modula-2 definitions and modules via the mc translator, constructs paranoid variants of the compiler and runtime archives, and regenerates target-independent Texinfo/ReST documentation from library definition modules, so it serves as the developer support layer above Make-lang.in.
